Joe Rogan turns to proof of early Christian psychedelic rites in ancient Rome in a segment from his show. The claim is that the first church used drug-laced wine or food in its rites. Rogan hosts the talk and weighs the claim.

Rogan works through the art, texts, and finds said to back the claim. He asks how much of it is proof and how much is a fun stretch. Would aliens interfere with human life? Rogan asks that question in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience, a bar-talk form of the old Fermi puzzle. If the sky is full of older species, their silence needs a reason, and meddling is one candidate.

The talk sorts the options: watchers who never touch, gardeners who nudge, and empires that would not care about us at all. Rogan ties the guesses to the UFO reports his guests have brought him for years. The segment is pure speculation, honestly labeled, and it shows the host thinking with his audience rather than at them.
